title: Constructed additive derived stalk isomorphism for open immersions
statement: Let j:X→Y be an open immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], x∈X, i∈ℤ, and fix derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] of sheaf modules on all schemes. Write H_Y for comparisonStalkCohomology Y (j x) i followed by forgetting to additive groups, and H_X analogously at x [lem-pc-stalk-comparison-source-transport]. Define openDerivedStalkIso(j,x,i):H_Y≅Lj*⋙H_X as follows. Identify tensorPullback j with the existing exact restrictFunctor j by uniqueness of its left adjunction to pushforward. The left-derived universal property [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] identifies derivedPullback j with restrictFunctor(j).mapDerivedCategory; call this openDerivedRestrictionIso. Its inverse, preceded by the exact-functor localization factor, defines openRestrictionRepresentativeIso(j,P):DQ(restrict(P))≅Lj*(DQ(P)). The exact module-stalk homology isomorphism, after forgetting scalars, identifies H_Y with sheaf homology followed by the additive stalk. Compose this with the inverse of restrictStalkNatIso, exact restriction's homology comparison, the inverse exact-stalk homology comparison on X, and the inverse derived-restriction comparison. This is the specified natural isomorphism, independent of every complex and every representing isomorphism. openRestrictionFunctor is only an abbreviation of the existing restriction with the common module-category spelling; its limits, colimits and additivity instances express exactness.

lean.statement:
def openDerivedStalkIso
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] (x : X) (i : ℤ) :
    comparisonStalkCohomology Y (j x) i ⋙
        forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (j x))) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ≅
      derivedPullback j ⋙ comparisonStalkCohomology X x i ⋙
        forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk x)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
